body:
TEST-ONLY synthetic fixture. Not ZoikoSuite fact.

# Security overview
Customer data is encrypted in transit and at rest, access is role-based with single sign-on and multi-factor authentication, and every change is recorded in an audit trail.
# Certifications
Certification and audit status is stated only from the signed claims registry; readiness work is never described as certification.
# Reporting a security issue
Security concerns are reported through the trust center so the security team can review them.
